scope_definition: Characterized trans-Neptunian surveys with published pointing history and quantified discovery, rate, magnitude, linking, and tracking selection functions; each survey remains a separate likelihood or predictive-score stratum.
confirmatory_interpretation: All currently named catalogs and published analyses are public and previously inspected. A survey-level holdout may be registered as held-out prediction only if its outcomes did not influence the exact model, grid, nuisance, candidate, or statistic choices. It is not a blinded-discovery sample.

required_survey_strata.required_scope: Complete eight-block OSSOS characterized release plus the affiliated CFEPS, HiLat, and Alexandersen characterized detections supported by the pinned native simulator.
required_survey_strata.selection_function_rule: Use only characterized detections and the exact matching pointing, magnitude/rate efficiency, linking, and tracking characterization. Deduplicate cross-survey rediscoveries by a prelocked identity rule.

required_survey_strata.required_scope: DES Year 6 characterized trans-Neptunian sample and the exact matching native survey simulator and selection characterization.
required_survey_strata.selection_function_rule: Score through the pinned DES simulator as an independent stratum; do not pool detections under the OSSOS selection function.

excluded_from_confirmatory_inference.reason: The matching selection function is not adequate for the registered survey-forward comparison.
Their combined pointing, non-detection, discovery, linking, and tracking selection history is not equivalently characterized.

unresolved_execution_blockers: Acquire and hash an exact finite survey-block and object inventory.
Acquire and hash every raw and reconstructed catalog and matching selection-function artifact.
Audit licenses, citations, retrieval locations, and stable archive destinations.
Freeze object eligibility, deduplication, orbital covariance, epoch, frame, color, and count-likelihood rules.
Audit whether any proposed holdout, candidate, endpoint, or cut was influenced by the same observations.
Either identify a genuinely untouched confirmation sample or explicitly lock the future claim to exploratory or held-out prediction.
nonclaim: This inventory names required survey strata but acquires no data and authorizes no analysis. It is not evidence for or against Planet X.
